sloka: अनुजग्मुश्च तं सर्वे मन्त्रिण: सपुरोहिता: ।बभूवुश्च मुदा युक्ता दृष्ट्वा तं वेश्मसंविधिम् ॥ २.९१.३६॥
transliteration: anujagmuśca taṁ sarve mantriṇa: sapurohitā: ।babhūvuśca mudā yuktā dṛṣṭvā taṁ veśmasaṁvidhim ॥ 2.91.36॥

translations.english: Longarmed Bharata, son of Kaikeyi entered that palace full of jewels with the permission of the great sage.
